Hi Amelia / Synapse team,

We’re seeing a reduction in throughput across our hosted inference pool that may be impacting some in-flight requests and batch jobs. We’ve posted a brief status update to the Redwood status page and our crew is investigating: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-02-21-reduced-throughput

What we know so far:
- Start time ~ 08:40 PST; elevated queueing and timeouts on select endpoints
- Affected: hosted inference (shared) pool in us-west-2 — some customers only see elevated tail latency, others see reduced throughput
- Not related to model code changes from customers

Immediate ask: can you share if you see any large spikes in request volume from your side in the 08:30–09:15 PST window? If so, reply with request IDs or approximate timestamps and we’ll correlate.

We’ll keep this thread updated. Apologies for the disruption — we know this impacts your processing windows.

Subject: Post-incident update and follow-up: reduced throughput incident (2026-02-21)

Hi Amelia / Synapse team,

Thank you for your patience while we resolved the throughput regression. This message summarizes the impact, root cause, remediation, and next steps. We’ve also posted the full postmortem and artifacts to the drive link below.

Summary of impact:
- Window: 2026-02-21 08:40–10:15 PST (approximately)
- Symptoms: Elevated queueing and reduced throughput on hosted inference shared pool in us-west-2. Some customer batch jobs retried and caused short bursts.
- Customers affected: subset of hosted customers (Synapse.ai observed a 3x spike on a batch job that retried), estimated tokens impacted: ~1.2M tokens across affected customers.

Root cause:
- A regression in the autoscaler introduced a longer ramp period for GPU pool scale-ups. When combined with a retry amplification loop in the orchestrator, a subset of nodes received high burst traffic and queued.

Remediation taken:
- Rolled back autoscaler to last known-good configuration (completed 09:30 PST on 2026-02-21).
- Temporary rate-limiting applied to orchestrator retries while a patch is validated.
- SRE replaced two affected nodes and drained queue backlog.

Customer impact and remediation offer:
- Based on logs, Synapse.ai had retries that increased load; however the degradation was service-side due to autoscaler behavior. We will apply a good-faith credit for the impacted tokens and priority migration assistance if you want to move critical nightly jobs to a dedicated pool.
- Attachment: sla_credit_calc.xlsx (preliminary estimate) — finance will finalize if you accept the credit.

Artifacts and next steps:
- Incident logs: incident_log_20260221.txt (attached)
- Postmortem doc: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/postmortem-synapse-20260221
- Status page: https://status.redwood.inference/incidents/2026-02-21-reduced-throughput

We value your partnership and are available to run a short review call if helpful. Please let us know if you want the credit applied directly to your invoice or if you prefer a one-time account credit.

Best,
